title: Hollowlands
description: A third-person survival and crafting game in a stylised, procedurally generated world. Explore, gather resources, craft tools, build and fight, on your own or online with other players.
how_to_play: Choose Singleplayer or Online Multiplayer. WASD to move, Shift to run, Space to jump and R to open your inventory. The first quests on screen get you started.
